Name: Dreamy Doctor Dialogue - Mud's Harvey to Harriet Rewrite
Author: TheMud
Description:
This is the first of my companion content mods to rewrite some characters to better match the (highly sexualized) designs featured in my portrait mods, focusing on Harriet, the female version of town doctor Harvey!

[b][u][color=#00ff00][size=5]Overview + Requirements[/size][/color][/u][/b]

This mod is made to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37227]Bountiful Beauties Volume II[/url] and won't make much sense without it! This mod was created because I felt Harvey's original game dialogue was all way too dry for the design I gave to his female version, focusing too much on his job or unsolicited health advice. All dialogue and heart events have been rewritten to introduce a new sleepy, floaty kind of personality while still keeping the character's vanilla traits. She still takes the health of the townspeople very seriously and is fascinated by airplanes, but she's not so good at watching her own health, and stays up too late all the time! As a result she's rather absent-minded and tends to forget something important while getting dressed...

[b][u]REQUIREMENTS:[/u][/b]

As mentioned this mod is meant to go with Bountiful Beauties Vol. II which requires Dialogue Display Framework Continued and Scale Up Unofficial. This mod additionally requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35027]StardewCGEvents 1.7.0+[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url].

Not tested in multiplayer but all players will need the mod or crashes will occur. Should work alongside other dialogue mods but obviously very incompatible with anything else that adds or changes Harvey's appearance.

Supports i18n for translations which are hosted on their own pages on Nexus.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3muG7sb.gif[/img]

Some changes have been made to her daily and weekly schedules. There could be mod conflicts when used with other mods that alter NPC schedules, so in the spoiler below are her changed schedules so you'll know if things are working:

[spoiler]
[u][b]Spring/Summer, Mondays and Wednesdays:[/b][/u]
At 8:30AM, she walks to the Clinic front counter like in vanilla. At 11:00AM, takes out a book to pass the time. At 2:00PM, falls asleep at the counter. At 3:00PM, she leaves the counter to walk around the spots in town Harvey does in vanilla (Harriet will be at the counter for three hours longer than vanilla). At 6:40PM, she will return home to her room, sitting down at her table to work on airplane models for way too long before going to sleep at midnight.

[u][b]Winter Mondays/Wednesdays, all season Friday/Saturday/Sunday:[/b][/u]
Follows vanilla schedules for the first half of the day on these days, but instead of reading in her room she will now either work on her models or go to the Saloon in the evening to eat for a few hours. The aim is to actually see her go someplace the player might visit, now that she leaves the house on Saturday evenings.

Her Fall work schedule, marriage schedules, and weekly appointments on Tuesdays and Thursdays are not changed.[/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37261/37261-1756917229-1040172347.png[/img]﻿

[b]Four of her heart events now feature new full-screen drawings that will (mostly) change with her current outfit, the player's gender, and the player's hair and skin color, thanks to the magic of StardewCGEvents[/b]! She also has one all-new 2-heart event taking place in the Clinic, but that happens to be the one CG that won't change with her outfit because I made it before I decided to add outfit matching. She'll have her coat on no matter what season it is.

[b]Want to see the CGs again without having to start a whole new game? No problem![/b]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37261/37261-1756917246-1326450736.png[/img][/b]

A new room has been added to the back of the Saloon, where a certain helpful mascot character will sell you paintings of each CG after seeing the events they're featured in. Before you've seen any events, all she'll have for sale is some coffee, though. [b]But wait, there's more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TeBnvKh.gif[/img][/b]﻿

These aren't just any ordinary paintings, they're interactable! Go up to them and press the use button to view the CGs at full size! They'll change with the seasons too so you can see variations that you didn't see in that playthrough!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37261/37261-1756917352-760540752.png[/img]﻿

Finally... during Spring and Fall, there is also a 15% chance per day she'll actually remember to put on her undies that day... but then forget something else...

[b][u][size=5][center][color=#00ffff]Socials + Other Stuff[/color][/center][/size][/u][/b]
I have more content mods in the works, which I'll be posting about on my [url=https://x.com/SuperMuddio]Twitter account @SuperMuddio[/url]! Besides working on additional volumes of Bountiful Beauties, I have other content mods in mind like another rewrite mod focusing on female Sam, and a few... let's call them "gameplay enhancements". If you'd like to help support my creative efforts, I have [url=https://www.patreon.com/mudsart]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://app.unifans.io/c/mudsart]Unifans[/url] (for those where Patreon is unavailable) accounts set up for donations!
